c2_bad.why: Streaks has no camera, no photos and no capture field anywhere; the screen under repair is a Swift Charts bar chart plus four stat tiles. Pulled in at lexical 0.008 purely to satisfy 'required coverage: interaction, accessible names, large touch targets'.
Nothing on the Stats screen is draggable. Selected only for 'required coverage: live region status announcements', a concern that is not part of a dark-mode contrast defect.

The header itself says 'uncovered required concepts (no record carries them for this context): a11y.contrast', and the trace shows a11y-contrast-text and a11y-nontext-contrast were dropped by the bundle cap. The entire defect is a 1.33:1 non-text contrast failure (accentSoft #4A2A22 on surface #1E1C1A); the WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 threshold - the one number needed to size the fix - still never reaches the implementer. process.reuse_first was also dropped, and impl-reuse-before-new was a record c1 actually used.

why: c2 gets the mode right (accessibility) and replaces c1's four ignored fillers (sticky bar, type measure, spacing scale, target size) with chart- and dark-palette-specific records (comp-chart-container, color-dark-accent) that c1 had wrongly suppressed as 'chart record outside a data-visualisation task'; but it still omits the 3:1 non-text contrast rule and the token-layer guidance, and it imports two new irrelevant records (photo capture, drag and drop).
